violations.description: Person in charge. — --Certified food service manager had an expired certificate or is no longer associated with this establishment. - Need current Food Service Manager

Preventing contamination during storage. — --Food item was not stored in a clean, dry location a minimum of 6 inches above the floor. - Food Items in walk-in freezer and walk-in cooler found on floor.

Refrigerated Storage. — --Refrigerator or cold storage was insufficient or ineffective at maintaining potentially hazardous food at a temperature of 41F or less. - Prep cooler found at 50F plus- all proteins sent to landfill.
Temperature measuring devices. — --Temperature measuring device was not provided. - Needed in Small reach in to the right of grille
Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Ventilation hood system was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required.

Date marking and disposition of ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food. — --Refrigerated, ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food (prepared more than 24 hours ago) was not properly date marked. - Many opened food items opened undated in prep cooler and walk-in cooler.
Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. - Prep cooler needs to be cleaned.
